self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Golden Majesty (R1): scoring hits on opponents increases ATK by 4% for 8s, up to 5 stacks (ATK +20% at max). While protected by a shield this bonus is doubled (ATK +40% at max stacks). Shield Strength +20% not modeled (non-combat). Quoted values are R1; this entry also declares its R5 values in refinementStates, and the leaderboard's chosen weapon refinement selects between them (R2-R4 read R1).

en.flavor: Capable of driving away evil spirits and wicked people alike, this edgeless claymore seems to possess divine might.

refinements.1: Increases Shield Strength by <r>20%</r>. Scoring hits on opponents increases ATK by <r>4%</r> for 8s. Max 5 stacks. Can only occur once every 0.3s. While protected by a shield, this ATK increase effect is increased by 100%.

refinements.5: Increases Shield Strength by <r>40%</r>. Scoring hits on opponents increases ATK by <r>8%</r> for 8s. Max 5 stacks. Can only occur once every 0.3s. While protected by a shield, this ATK increase effect is increased by 100%.

fr.flavor: Capable d'éloigner les esprits et les individus mal intentionnés, cette épée à deux mains dénuée de tranchant est habitée par une puissance divine.
